verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or community evidence about exporting GitHub data (repos, issues, projects, org data) in open formats or about account/data portability features; all citations concern Copilot, security tooling, CI/CD, or unrelated outage/community complaints. Missing for 10: any mention of GitHub's data export settings, GDPR/data portability tools, or documentation confirming open-format exports (e.g., git as portable format, issue/PR export).
